test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Vanquish
solution:
The correct answer is **Defeat.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for the given options is Defeat.
 
• **Vanquish **means** defeat thoroughly.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is** **Defeat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Acquit- It means **free (someone) from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty.**
 
• **Surrender- **It means** give up or hand over.**
 
• **Flee - **It means **running away from a place or situation of danger**.
